Support the ultimate neurodiverse hub and make a difference today:

Your contribution enables neurodiverse individuals to connect and engage in meaningful activities

Every contribution no matter the size, aids our hub

Help us create a positive impact in our community

Help Us To Make A Difference!

What Our Stakeholders Say About Us

Make a donation

To continue our mission and expand our offerings, we kindly ask for your support through donations. Your contributions will help us maintain our programs and ensures that every individual in our community has access to the resources they need to thrive. Together we can make a meaningful impact and foster a brighter future for all.

“Neurodiversity is the key to unlocking the potential of every human being.”

“The world needs all kinds of minds”...“Autism is not a tragedy. Ignorance is the real tragedy.”

“Our brains are wired differently, not wrongly.”

Since 2015, BF4A has supported over 1,000 families by offering vital services, where 90% of our delivery is FREE.

From Croydon’s first-ever, free SEND After-School Clubs, Integrated Holiday Clubs, to tutoring, therapy & youth development & career guidance, we recognise that when families are supported, children thrive.

Your support helps us continue building safe, inclusive spaces where every child and parent feels seen, heard, and empowered.

Donate time, resources & ideas to help sponsor our student and family programmes!

Contact us for further information:

Our Stories - From the people we have helped with our SEND After-School Clubs

“This is a much-needed club for working parents of children with SEND. My son has loved going every week. It is set up to meet his needs. He is safe and happy. He has started to make new social interactions and friendships. It gives me a break as he is well looked after by staff there.Well done to Karen and her team.”

“It has been really good. I have enjoyed supporting the children who are like me. I have learnt from the adults like Mrs Modupe and it has helped to improve my confidence”.

 Nathaniel, a teenager, SEND volunteer.

I have enjoyed supporting the children who are like me.

Miss Diallo, helped me to learn and get better in my English and Maths. When I found something difficult she taught me a better way to understand. I am now more confident in my studies.

Cara has gained huge confidence over the last 2 years in her English skills while being in BF4A. In GCSE's her levels have increased from a predicted grade 3 to grade 5.

Joel joined Mrs Bryson's 11+ Class and made significant improvement, passing both English and Maths for three grammar school's of his choice. He accepted Wilsons Grammar school in March 2021.
